description: Validator parity cases (Kiro, task 37.3). Each scene is run through backend/app/validate.py validate_scene and frontend/src/share/validate.ts validateShareScene. `expected` is the verdict both should give. When `known_mismatch` is true, `backend` and `frontend` record what each one gives today; see docs/reports/validator-parity.md. Reason keys: coord_out_of_range, dropped_referenced, no_drawable, too_many_points, colour_only_label, invalid_kind, bad_version, empty_id, polyline_too_short, polyline_too_long, too_many_facts, too_many_bars.

cases.name: coord_at_1_02
cases.note: x = 1.02 is inside the tolerance; clamped to 1.

cases.name: coord_at_minus_0_02
cases.note: x = -0.02 is inside the tolerance.

cases.name: coord_just_over_1_02_unused
cases.note: x = 1.0201 on a point nothing uses.

cases.name: coord_just_over_1_02_used
cases.note: x = 1.0201 on a point a segment uses.

cases.name: nan_string_unused
cases.note: x = "NaN" (a string) on a point nothing uses.

cases.name: infinity_string_unused
cases.note: x = "Infinity" (a string) on a point nothing uses.

cases.name: numeric_string_unused
cases.note: x = "0.5" (a string) on a point nothing uses.

cases.name: nan_string_used
cases.note: x = "NaN" (a string) on a point a segment uses.

cases.name: duplicate_id_point_and_segment
cases.note: A segment with the id of a point; both rename it A_2.

cases.name: duplicate_point_ids
cases.note: Two points with id A; the second becomes A_2.

cases.name: duplicate_id_point_and_bar
cases.note: A bar with the id of a point.

cases.name: dangling_endpoint
cases.note: Segment to a missing point Z is dropped.

cases.name: dangling_endpoint_named_in_facts
cases.note: The dropped segment CZ is named in a fact.

cases.name: segment_a_equals_b
cases.note: Neither validator rejects a segment from a point to itself.

cases.name: empty_scene
cases.note: No elements at all.

cases.name: empty_arrays
cases.note: Empty element arrays.

cases.name: points_300
cases.note: At the share cap.

cases.name: points_301
cases.note: Over the 300 share cap, under the 500 backend cap (deliberate).

cases.name: points_501
cases.note: Over both caps.

cases.name: aspect_0
cases.note: aspect = 0: the backend resets or clamps it, the share validator drops it.

cases.name: aspect_1e200
cases.note: aspect = 1e+200: the backend resets or clamps it, the share validator drops it.

cases.name: aspect_negative
cases.note: aspect = -2: the backend resets or clamps it, the share validator drops it.

cases.name: very_long_label
cases.note: A 500-character label; both cut it to 60.

cases.name: colour_only_label
cases.note: A label that is only a colour word ("red", Requirement 3.6).

cases.name: unknown_kind
cases.note: kind is not one of the four.

cases.name: version_2
cases.note: Only version 1 exists.

cases.name: empty_point_id
cases.note: A point with an empty id.

cases.name: polyline_one_point
cases.note: A curve with a single point.

cases.name: polyline_1001_points
cases.note: One curve with 1001 points: over the backend's 1000 per curve, under the share cap of 2000 in total.

cases.name: bar_value_nan_string_only_bar
cases.note: The only bar has value "NaN" (a string).

cases.name: facts_101
cases.note: 101 facts: the backend rejects over 100; the share validator keeps the first 50 and accepts.

cases.name: bars_61
cases.note: 61 bars: over the 60 share cap, under the 100 backend cap (same pattern as points).

cases.name: reserved_title_with_segment
cases.note: Lane a1 oracle (Kiro, task 40.3, Requirement 24.2): accept, no reserved id, unique ids, every segment joins the same two points (matched by position). A point called title joined to B.

cases.name: reserved_case_variants
cases.note: Lane a1 oracle (Kiro, task 40.3, Requirement 24.2): accept, no reserved id, unique ids, every segment joins the same two points (matched by position). Title, TITLE, scene:title, __proto__, constructor, and a segment id valueOf.

cases.name: reserved_rename_collides
cases.note: Lane a1 oracle (Kiro, task 40.3, Requirement 24.2): accept, no reserved id, unique ids, every segment joins the same two points (matched by position). title is renamed while a point el_title already exists.
